marks.text: locates certificate verification in the x509 layer and names a concrete file — `library/x509_crt.c` or `include/mbedtls/x509_crt.h`. A file that does not exist in this tree does not earn the mark however plausible its name

names a public entry point, or the profile-taking form the simple one delegates to — any of `mbedtls_x509_crt_verify` (`include/mbedtls/x509_crt.h:3159`), `mbedtls_x509_crt_verify_with_profile` (`:3176`), `mbedtls_x509_crt_verify_restartable` (`:3210`) or `mbedtls_x509_crt_verify_with_ca_cb` (`library/x509_crt.c`). Any ONE earns the mark; a name outside this set does not

evidence: symbol `mbedtls_x509_crt_verify` — - `mbedtls_x509_crt_verify()` — verifies a certificate chain against trusted CAs `include/mbedtls/x509_crt.h:3159`
symbol `mbedtls_x509_crt_verify_with_profile` — - `mbedtls_x509_crt_verify_with_profile()` — verifies with a security profile `include/mbedtls/x509_crt.h:3159` (depth 1 call to restartable version)
symbol `mbedtls_x509_crt_verify_restartable` — - `mbedtls_x509_crt_verify_restartable()` — restartable version for interruptible verification `include/mbedtls/x509_crt.h:3159` (depth 1 wrapper)

judge.why: The answer lays out the ordered sequence of checks (name → key/algorithm → chain/time/parent/CRL → signature crypto), not just where the code lives.

marks.text: **treats chain building as distinct from the per-certificate checks** — finding a parent and verifying its signature is different work from checking a name or a validity date

judge.quote:
"**Chain Verification** — `x509_crt_verify_chain()` `library/x509_crt.c:2511`
   - Builds the certificate chain from end-entity to root
   - For each certificate in chain:
     - **Time validation**... 
     - **Parent finding** — `x509_crt_find_parent()`" together with separately-listed "Name Verification" as its own numbered step distinct from chain building
judge.why: The answer separates parent-finding/chain assembly (x509_crt_verify_chain, x509_crt_find_parent, signature verification via x509_crt_check_signature) as its own pipeline stage distinct from per-cert checks like name verification and time/profile checks.

marks.text: **includes REVOCATION as part of verification** — `x509_crt_verifycrl` (`library/x509_crt.c:2015`) is called for each chain link from `x509_crt_verify_chain` (`:2511`, the call at `:2680`) and sets `MBEDTLS_X509_BADCERT_REVOKED` (`:2115`), and the whole CRL path is a separately compiled option (`MBEDTLS_X509_CRL_PARSE_C`, `:1991`-`:2124`). Naming the CRL check, the revoked flag, or the fact that revocation is optional at compile time earns the mark; presenting chain building plus the per-certificate checks as the whole of verification is incomplete
